name: alternate_titles
description: A list of alternate titles for this publisher. Example: ["Springer"]

name: cited_by_count
description: The number of citations to works that are linked to this publisher through journals or other sources.

name: country_codes
description: The countries where the publisher is primarily located, as an ISO two-letter country code. Example: ["DE", "GB"]

name: counts_by_year
description: works_count and cited_by_count for each of the last ten years: new works linked to this publisher in that year, and citations received in that year.

fields.name: year
fields.description: The year the counts refer to. Example: 2024

fields.name: works_count
fields.description: Number of works published in that year.

fields.name: cited_by_count
fields.description: Number of citations received in that year.

fields.name: oa_works_count
fields.description: Number of open access works from this publisher in the given year.

name: created_date
description: The date this Publisher object was created in the OpenAlex dataset, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. Example: 2017-08-08

name: display_name
description: The primary name of the publisher. Example: Springer Nature

name: hierarchy_level
description: Level of this publisher in the publisher hierarchy: 0 = no parent publisher, 1 = one parent above it, and so on. Possible values: 0 | 1 | 2

name: id
description: The OpenAlex ID for this publisher. Example: https://openalex.org/P4310320595

name: ids
description: External identifiers OpenAlex holds for this publisher. IDs are expressed as URIs where possible.

fields.name: openalex
fields.description: This publishers's OpenAlex ID. Example: https://openalex.org/P4310320595

fields.name: wikidata
fields.description: This publisher's Wikidata ID. Example: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q230492

name: image_thumbnail_url
description: Same as image_url, but it's a smaller image.

name: image_url
description: URL of an image representing this publisher, usually a logo hosted on Wikimedia.

name: roles
description: List of role objects, which include the role (one of institution, funder, or publisher), the id (OpenAlex ID), and the works_count.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role this organisation plays in OpenAlex. Possible values: institution | funder | publisher

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the entity record for that role. Example: https://openalex.org/I27837315, https://openalex.org/F4320306076, https://openalex.org/P4310320595

fields.name: works_count
fields.description: Number of works linked to the organisation in that role.

name: sources_api_url
description: OpenAlex API URL listing the sources of this publisher. Example: https://api.openalex.org/sources?filter=host_organization.id:P4310320595

fields.name: 2yr_mean_citedness
fields.description: The 2-year mean citedness for this publisher. Also known as impact factor. Example: 3.14

fields.name: h_index
fields.description: The h-index for this publisher. Example: 42

fields.name: i10_index
fields.description: The i-10 index for this publisher. Example: 120

name: updated_date
description: The last time anything in this publisher object changed, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. This date is updated for any change at all, including increases in various counts. Example: 2026-10-12T05:31:44.211000

name: works_count
description: The number of works published by this publisher.

name: parent_publisher
description: Unverified shape (string ID or object); JSON type accepts either Example: "https://openalex.org/P4310319965" (or an object with id and display_name)
